text:
maria: Quick checkpoint on Tenant-42 deploy gate — listing current snags we need to clear before we flip traffic. TL;DR: firewall rules, image sync, cert rotation. @raj can you take firewall? @kevin can you handle image sync? I'll own certs. I'll paste details below.

raj: on it. first question: do we need 10.10.0.0/16 egress open to S3 endpoints in us-west-2? customer says their NAT is locked down.

kevin: I tried an image rsync last night; saw permissions error from registry. Pasting log:
```
error: access denied: 403
```
Likely IAM role missing.

maria: thanks. raj - yes S3 is required. Add 10.10.0.0/16 -> s3-us-west-2 endpoints. We'll prefer VPC endpoints instead of opening to internet. customer security asked for no NAT if possible.

raj: confirming with netops. If VPC endpoint not allowed, we can add a proxy policy. ETA 3pm PST.

sophia: FYI I ran the cert renewal on staging; leaf cert expired earlier. Root CA rotation needed here. Maria, do you have the CA bundle from the customer? I saw they sent something in the onboarding doc.

maria: I have the bundle but it's in a zip behind their SSO. I'll request a shared URL. Meanwhile, kevin: can you switch to --insecure-skip-tls for the rsync to unblock staging? Not for prod.

kevin: I can, but need approval from security. tagging @alex-sec for a quick thumbs.

alex-sec: :thumbsup: okay for staging only. Make sure to revert. Also we need an audit entry.

infra-bot: deploy-canary: Tenant-42 image-sync canary started (id: c-9f3). Logs: https://logs.redwood.example/c-9f3

kevin: I pushed a temp IAM policy to the registry role to allow GetObject. test pass on staging. Will cut a PR to revert later: #repos/infra/tenants#182

raj: netops confirmed VPC S3 endpoint allowed; they need aws:SourceVpc condition, sending the exact policy snippet:
```
"Condition": {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0bb1"}}
```
Pushed to the customer ticket.

maria: great. action items: raj = add endpoint + firewall ACL by 15:00, kevin = PR to patch iam & revert, maria = request CA bundle and coordinate cert rotation, sophia = smoke tests after certs. If any blocker remains by 17:00 we'll pause cutover. :calendar: 

kevin: one more: registry ttl for manifests is 30m. For big rsync we'll hit rate limits. Suggest we increase concurrency/batch size. @maria ok to request a short window with customer?

maria: yes, request short window. I'll message customer ops for a 60m bump starting 16:00 PST.

sophia: noting test plan: connectivity -> image sync -> cert rotate -> health checks -> small traffic shift. I'll paste healthcheck commands after lunch.

raj: If anyone needs me after 15:00 I'm around for followups. :hand:
